messages:
Sarah: quick sync — final prep for nx-12 model serve tomorrow. need short check: weights location, tokenizer quirk, config lint, golden prompts, and toolcall smoke. can ppl drop status?

Raj: weights are uploaded to s3://redwood-weights/nx-12/v1/ — files: model.bin, params.json, tokenizer.json. i ran md5 on model.bin -> `e3b0c442...` — looks good.

Lina: tokenizer.json has extra `eos` token named `</s>` plus a deprecated `</end>` entry. that trips our tokenizer merge logic (we saw duplicated EOS tokens). workaround: add a map in the loader to prefer `</s>`. i'll push a tiny shim.

Mike: config.yaml linted. main differences vs template: `max_batch_tokens: 4096` and `kv_cache: enabled`. added `fallback_model: nx-8` for capacity SLOs. posted diff here: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/merge/4321 (PR in review).

Eva: golden prompt set: added 12 structured outputs to goldenset/nx-12/regen.jsonl. includes toolcall cases for calendar and calculator. i flagged 2 samples with ambiguous tool intent — we should decide acceptance criteria.

Sarah: thanks. Lina — can you paste the loader shim snippet? want to include in onboarding checklist.

Lina: sure — minimal patch: ```py
# tokenizer_shim.py
def normalize_special_tokens(toks):
    if toks.get('</end>') and not toks.get('</s>'):
        toks['</s>'] = toks.pop('</end>')
    return toks
```
will open PR to model-onboard repo.

Raj: noting weights perms: i set bucket policy to allow service-account-inference role with s3:GetObject. if dedicated tenants need access, we'll add cross-account role later.

Mike: CI smoke job passed on staging nodes. deploy-bot: can you run a quick toolcall smoke with nx-12 on stg?

deploy-bot: ran pipeline `stg-toolcall-smoke nx-12 v1` — results: 50/50 toolcall success rate (50 samples). failures were timeouts when trying external calendar API (429). logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/logs/9876.

Eva: reasessing toolcall tests — we should mock external APIs for smoke so flaky 429s don't fail the gating. i'll add a mock for calendar endpoint and re-run.

Sarah: good plan. also need structured-output lint: ensure `response.metadata.schema_version` is present. Lina add a quick check in the runtime validator.

Lina: added validator rule locally: ```yaml
- path: response.metadata.schema_version
  required: true
  type: semver
```
will include in PR.

Raj: one more: tokenizer vocab path in params.json points to `tokenizer.json` relative path; loader resolves relative to weights root, so it's fine. just callout for docs.

Eva: for golden acceptance — propose: if any structured output diff > 3 fields or any toolcall mismatch (tool name or args), mark as regression. otherwise minor formatting diffs allowed. ok with that?

Mike: sounds reasonable. can we automerge small formatting-only differences? i've been burned by churn.

Sarah: yes — Lina add a `format_only` comparator that ignores whitespace and casing for free-text fields. Eva add that to eval config.

Lina: done, pushed to PR branch `nx-12-onboard-fixes`. PR link: https://git.internal/redwood/model-onboard/pull/210

Raj: i'll approve weights perms & mc later today.

deploy-bot: note — scheduled canary deploy to dedicated pool at 2026-03-18T02:00Z.

Sarah: perfect. action items: Lina PR for tokenizer shim + validator, Eva update goldens and mocks, Mike finish config PR, Raj confirm perms. i'll collate into the onboarding checklist and post final. thanks :thumbsup:

Mike: ack :eyes:

Eva: will re-run toolcall smoke after mocks, will ping here when done.

Lina: PR opened, added test.

Raj: perms set pending one more review.

Sarah: end — will post checklist URL once compiled.
